name: @tradrl/search-lineage
description: Search-lineage contracts (Work Order T031): the immutable, append-only SEARCH RECORD — every optimization trial with its content-addressed config snapshot, its parent links (the search DAG), the data-split ids it consumed, the evaluation-policy ref, the in-search vs holdout classification, and the per-entry hash CHAIN that makes hiding or rewriting a trial a typed error (ARCHITECTURE-LOCK L11/L4/L9/L12; spec/EVALUATION-PROTOCOL.md 'Selection integrity'; R20).
